statements.text: From housing to health care, AI is increasingly being used to make consequential decisions, diagnoses, recommendations, and predictions that can significantly alter our lives. Consumers deserve to know whether the chatbots they use are truly helping them — or quietly feeding them blurred advertising. I’m calling on AI companies to be transparent about their advertising plans and explain how they will build in safeguards. Privacy and safety cannot be an afterthought. https://t.co/0PEVjvTphi

Anthropic has announced that Claude will remain ad-free. I’m glad to see @AnthropicAI agrees that ads in AI chatbots can pose serious risks to its users. That’s why I opened an investigation into AI chatbots’ advertising plans. Companies must put consumers first.

What’s described here isn’t isolated—it’s systemic. Embedded bias in AI has real-world consequences. My AI Civil Rights Act would put strict guardrails on algorithms to prevent bias and discrimination. Innovation without safeguards isn’t progress. https://t.co/5W5x4gFmiA

DOD is still coercing Anthropic to allow its AI model to be used for mass surveillance and autonomous warfare. Imagine what they have planned. 

This can’t happen. https://t.co/OMESc1kY8g
My statement demanding immediate congressional action to reverse DOD's designation of Anthropic a supply chain risk. https://t.co/iBW9jhGKkt
We need answers about how AI is being used in Trump's illegal war with Iran.
statements.quoted:
To strike 1,000 targets in 24 hours in Iran, the U.S. military leveraged the most advanced AI it’s ever used in warfare.

Anthropic’s Claude partnered with the military’s Maven Smart System, suggesting targets and issuing precise location coordinates. https://t.co/dDQ8KoWdVT https://t.co/EcFoJ0NOAy

statements.text: Electricity rates are spiking as AI data centers pop up across the country. Households and small businesses should not be made to subsidize data centers while they already struggle to get by. Our nation's public utility commissions set household rates--they can act now. https://t.co/1aNfneDiYg

President Trump is continuing to repay Big Tech’s campaign donations by proposing to block states from protecting their communities from AI-related harms. [...] We should pass my States’ Right to Regulate AI Act to put power back into the hands of people, not the Big Tech billionaire boys club cozying up to the White House.
statements.venue: Press release, statement on Trump AI legislative framework

statements.text: Trump is calling on Congress to block states from regulating AI. I’ve successfully struck this down before and I’ll do it again. While the White House chooses to line the pockets of Big Tech billionaires, Congress must protect kids, workers and communities from the harms of AI.

AI chatbots pose grave new risks to kids’ privacy and safety, but Big Tech continues to speak only one language: profit. [...] Right now, these chatbots can collect a kid’s deepest thoughts, feelings, and fears, and then use that information to keep them coming back. You wouldn’t let a stranger do that to your child. A chatbot shouldn’t get to either.
statements.venue: Press release, Youth AI Privacy Act introduction

statements.text: AI chatbots pose new dangers to kids’ safety. But Big Tech keeps using the same playbook: prioritizing profit over privacy. Today I introduced the Youth AI Privacy Act to stop chatbots from exploiting kids' sensitive information and using manipulative design to keep them hooked.

For six years, I have been sounding the alarm on Clearview AI. Now, a grandmother was jailed for over 5 months for crimes in a state she’s never visited. This technology is biased, inaccurate, and unreliable. It destroys lives. https://t.co/nZaOHs4iPB

I introduced the Youth AI Privacy Act to protect kids from the harms of AI chatbots. No ads to kids. No profiling. No addictive design tricks. Children and teens’ privacy must come first. https://t.co/9Tw1advYGb

In the age of AI, our top priority needs to be protecting American workers—not replacing them. Grateful to discuss this and more with Massachusetts Youth Democrats at our town hall this Saturday. https://t.co/idpxfANyJQ

Thank you to @CWAUnion for bringing together workers from across the country to fight for their rights in the age of AI.
 
I am proud to stand with workers and say NO to robot bosses and NO to spying on employees. The future of work must be one where AI stands for All Included. https://t.co/j2pKKGEaas

My AI Environmental Impacts Act would require data centers to report on air quality, water use, noise pollution, light pollution, land use, and energy use. Communities are already feeling these impacts. We need more, but the least our government can do is give us the truth.
I’ve led the charge to stop Trump’s outrageous efforts to block state AI regulations before. I’m ready to do it again.
statements.quoted: Scoop: White House, Hill relaunch effort to block state AI laws https://t.co/Xv3vgZ63kg

statements.text:
Workers should be managed by people, not a machine.

I’m proud to partner with the @AFLCIO on the No Robot Bosses Act and Stop Spying Bosses Act to stop AI management, rein in workplace surveillance, and put workers back in control of their autonomy, privacy, and rights. https://t.co/eLTHeniMnH

Amazon received $17.5 billion in tax subsidies last year. They made $78 billion in profit. On Prime Day, don’t buy Amazon’s excuse that they can't pay workers more. Let's pass my bipartisan Warehouse Worker Protection Act, ban worker surveillance & stop AI from being your boss.

Bias in AI can cost people jobs. When AI discriminates, real people pay the price. That’s why I introduced the AI Civil Rights Act—to mitigate bias, require transparency and accountability, and protect opportunity for everyone.
statements.quoted:
Stanford University researchers analyzed 4 million job applications and found that 26% of Black applicants and 15% of Asian applicants applied to jobs where AI hiring systems worked against their racial group.

The researchers estimate that if those candidates had been recommended at the same rate as the most-favored group, roughly 40,000 additional applications would have advanced to the next stage of hiring.

statements.text: For too long, the conversation about artificial intelligence has been about what’s next — the next breakthrough, the next headline, the next promise of the future. But the American people need more than future promises; they need answers to what’s happening right now.

AI is hurting workers, kids, and communities across our country. That’s why I’m introducing an AI Accountability Agenda to give the power back to workers, protect our kids, eliminate AI bias, and stop the extreme environmental costs of data centers. https://t.co/JORGJjkPps

The harms of AI aren't hypothetical. They're happening right now. That is why I'm releasing my AI Accountability Agenda—a comprehensive legislative plan to take power back from Big Tech and put commonsense protections in place for workers, kids, and communities across the country.

Yesterday, I voted to block Trump’s plan to let AI decide whether Medicare will approve or deny your medical care. Every Senate Republican supported Trump’s scheme. Doctors should be deciding what care seniors need – not a computer program.

I am grateful for the support of so many families, kids, and experts for my Youth AI Privacy Act. This legislation includes strong, enforceable protections against manipulative, invasive AI chatbots. It’s time for Congress to act.

Families deserve strong protections against AI chatbots—that's why my Youth AI Privacy Act delivers by banning AI companies from using manipulative designs that exploit young people’s emotions and create chatbot dependency. 

My message for Big Tech: stop exploiting kids.

With the release of my AI Accountability Agenda, I am making a promise to families across America: I will fight to take back power from Big Tech and put it into the hands of the American people. AI must stand for Accountability and Inclusion, not Abuse and Injury. https://t.co/ROWh1wERuv

The Commerce Committee's passage of my Youth AI Privacy Act is a huge step towards protecting kids’ privacy & safety in the age of AI. This strong bipartisan support for privacy safeguards in AI chatbots draws a clear line: Big Tech must prioritize kids over their bottom line.

I'm proud that COPPA helped hold Meta accountable—but we cannot stop here. Congress must pass my bills stopping Big Tech’s relentless surveillance of kids and the new threats from AI chatbots. We must prioritize our young people, not Big Tech’s profits. https://t.co/z1UhlgzpiC

Today’s settlement sends a clear message: Big Tech must put kids’ well-being first. However, we cannot rely on court cases alone. Congress must also pass strong legislation including COPPA 2.0, which would update my original COPPA law, and my Youth AI Privacy Act to protect kids in this digital age.

Big Tech has shown they will stop at nothing in the Faustian pursuit of “innovation” posing life-threatening risks to our kids, our environment, our workers, and our rights. We need to pass my AI Accountability agenda to address current harms now and act to stop existential threats to our future.

OpenAI admitted its agents hacked an Australian government website—three months after it happened.

We can’t trust these companies to admit their failures. We need a Cybersecurity & AI Board of Investigations to demand answers from the rogue people behind these “rogue agents.” https://t.co/s1P7WUyFlM

Donald Trump is like AI itself—over confident, often wrong, and prone to hallucinating facts. His “morally binding” agreement means nothing. 

We can’t let Big Tech regulate itself. Congress must act now.

Elon Musk advising Trump on warfare is just handing over your taxpayer money to a trillionaire. Musk will push his AI and space technologies, make money from defense contracts, then pour that money into MAGA campaigns. Corruption in plain sight. https://t.co/CJPv1v4k0e

A family alleges that Google’s Gemini helped their daughter make a suicide plan after she accessed it on a school-issued device.
 
Meanwhile, Google is forcing schools to keep AI features or lose Search. Schools deserve safeguards, not ultimatums.
 
Google must reverse this policy.
